decision.reason: ApxInf does not yet expose the resident HTTP measurement lane and its current EOG selection policy is not equivalent to the OmniInfer request's ignore_eos policy. The host is also outside the formal quiet-host gate.

DEPLOYMENT_AH_VS_OG.question: How do the disclosed ApxInf and OmniInfer deployments compare at one persistent HTTP client's complete-response boundary?
DEPLOYMENT_AH_VS_OG.classification: named deployment comparison, not an engine-only or equal-artifact comparison
DEPLOYMENT_AH_VS_OG.ApxInf_weight_and_kv_regime: custom G32/G64 W8 hybrid with CPU F32 remainder and F32 KV
DEPLOYMENT_AH_VS_OG.OmniInfer_weight_and_kv_regime: Q8_0 GGUF through the pinned llama.cpp-mac backend; KV regime must be restated by the future campaign receipt
DEPLOYMENT_AH_VS_OG.required_disclosure: weight serialization, quantization, KV precision, placement, prompt processing, EOG policy, runtime commit, binary hash, and timing boundary remain explicit

GATEWAY_B_VS_G.question: What client-observed increment is introduced by routing the same resident llama.cpp backend through OmniInfer?
GATEWAY_B_VS_G.classification: same-backend gateway-path comparison, not engine throughput

canonical_http_workload_candidate.note: The request's model field is an opaque served alias for the named-deployment edge. It must not be interpreted as proof that ApxInf loaded the GGUF named by that field.

B1_resident_apxinf_http_lane.requirement: Load one ApxInf model once, retain the model and Metal buffers for the campaign, and expose strict health, state, checked cache-clear, and chat-completions routes on one persistent connection.

B2_checked_reset_integration.candidate_progress: GeneralQwen35::reset_checked is implemented in this candidate, exposed through the object-safe LlmTrait and LoadedModel paths, and its CPU success, injected KV-clear failure, stale-KV postcondition, Metal receipt clearing, Metal GDN reset, and fused terminal recovery paths are unit-tested.
B2_checked_reset_integration.remaining_requirement: The future HTTP clear route must call reset_checked exactly once outside the measured generation interval, arm exactly one reset epoch, validate zero mutable receipts, and terminate the campaign on any reset error.

B3_eog_policy_equivalence.current_apxinf_policy: select and feed back EOG without termination and without EOG-logit suppression
B3_eog_policy_equivalence.requirement: Freeze one identical EOG-logit policy for both lanes and repeat token-level semantic admission before performance sampling. Equal returned-token count alone is insufficient.

B4_common_timing_boundary.requirement: Use the same client implementation and clock. Time immediately before the complete request-wire send through complete response-body read and strict JSON plus semantic validation. Do not join or subtract runtime-native prompt, predicted, TTFT, or TPOT metrics across lanes.

B5_quiet_host.requirement: Pass the predeclared live-main, power, thermal, memory-pressure, external-load, runtime-custody, and no-interference gates before campaign start and after every measurement block.

required_resident_http_state_machine.clear_transition: healthy_unarmed -> healthy_armed(epoch=N) only after one successful reset_checked and zero-state receipt
required_resident_http_state_machine.generation_transition: healthy_armed(epoch=N) -> healthy_unarmed after consuming the epoch before generation
forbidden: generation without an armed reset epoch
two cache clears without an intervening generation
implicit reset inside the measured generation handler
retry, reconnect, resample, replacement, or continued service after any non-200, reset error, generation error, custody error, or semantic mismatch

future_admission_receipts: exact 383-byte request body and 13 prompt token IDs
one acknowledged reset epoch per generation outside the timing boundary
exactly 128 returned raw token IDs and finish_reason length
one CPU prefill and 127 fused decode calls with zero teacher calls
no prompt-cache reuse, speculative decoding, continuous batching, retry, reconnect, or replacement
start/end equality for source, binary, model artifacts, loaded file identities, runtime closure, resident-buffer ledger, PID, and socket identity
counterbalanced paired schedule and all predeclared stability gates

side_by_side_summary.classification: diagnostic observations with no cross-runtime ratio or ranking

same_backend_gateway_summary.classification: valid one-shot diagnostic but statistically inconclusive

claim_boundary.allowed_now: A persistent-HTTP ApxInf-versus-OmniInfer named-deployment comparison is technically feasible, and the repository records the exact missing admissions before it can be run honestly.
not_allowed_now: ApxInf is faster or slower than OmniInfer
a direct ApxInf/OmniInfer speed ratio or delta
the current side-by-side native timing observations share one timing boundary
the existing gateway point estimate establishes positive overhead or practical equivalence
